t: This is the home ground of Allison and Busby, a British publishing house based in London. It was established in 1967 by Clive Allison and Margaret Busby. Busby was Britain's youngest publisher and the first black female book publisher in the UK. She later edited the anthology Daughters of Africa, followed by New Daughters of Africa in 2019, and has received the Royal Society of Literature's Benson Medal. In 2021 she was honoured with the London Book Fair Lifetime Achievement Award. Allison and Busby is where that story began.
